method: Independent real page-reload smoke test at a declared geographic station selected from the long trip. Initial placement only before the smoke test; actual car input creates the save. Reload uses existing localStorage and normal resume action, never an injected save. This is NOT retroactively a reload during the already archived 40km or 21km trip.
